scope: Original Practice TutorialController and its mounted source screens; external progress/spawn/arena transition remain host-owned

native_behavior.initialize_gate: GameMode == Practice(2), ProgressController exists, IsTutorialPassed == false
native_behavior.initialize: Subscribe original pressed/released handlers; deactivate container and four screens; reset step 0; Exit all then Enter step 0; Invoke HideInGameTopBar after .1 scaled seconds
native_behavior.next: Only when NetworkedGameController exists and State == Round(4), increment step; enter if it is below the screen-array length
native_behavior.no_button: The source OnClickedNo is a 4-byte branch at VA 0x3444134 to OnClickedFight at VA 0x3444138
native_behavior.fight_button: Exit all tutorial screens; show TopBar; MarkTutorialPassed if progress exists; if progress and transition owners exist, set Campaign level 1, stage 1, then request TransitionToArena(Campaign=0)
native_behavior.pressed: dxo VA 0x3444388, fade all three hands groups to alpha 0 over .1 scaled seconds with OutCubic(9); no CancelInvoke
native_behavior.released: dxp VA 0x3444398, CancelInvoke ShowAllTutorialHands then Invoke it after 1 scaled second
native_behavior.show_hands: Fade all groups to alpha 1 over .1 scaled seconds, OutCubic(9), no DOKill/SetUpdate/SetLink
native_behavior.disable: Remove both hand input handlers; no CancelInvoke or target tween kill
native_behavior.cinemachine_brain: Serialized reference is retained in export, but these 16 methods do not read or change it
native_behavior.rig_and_input: These methods do not select character/configuration, alter weapon/physics state, or block/gate the player's input

live_methodinfo_evidence.method: Read-only original APK GOT -> MethodInfo slot -> MethodInfo -> methodPointer, using validated PT_LOAD base; no APK or runtime field/instruction writes

external_context_and_limits: The helper requires actual game-mode, progress-presence/passed flag, MarkTutorialPassed, network-state and transition owner callbacks. It never invents a save, campaign progression or a Friendly substitute for Practice.

Practice character spawning, original profiles/configuration, arena construction and the Campaign transition implementation belong to the corresponding owning controllers and are not implemented by TutorialController.
Input callbacks must be raised once for each original successful hand pointer press/release. They are not combined into only first-touch/final-release notifications.

English uses exact original localization strings, including source typos/carriage returns. All 11 source language columns are retained, but secondary font/material localization and a global language-switch service are not restored here.

Original UIInputManagerLite/GamepadUIButton and global button SFX/selection components are exported as auxiliary source evidence; their service behavior is not represented as recovered by this 16-method helper. Default imported touch containers match the current mobile reference.

The numeric oracle bounds engine/UITransitionAnimator/service calls at original ABI boundaries. Those call decisions and ordering are verified; a combined original APK versus Unity tutorial input/visual trajectory comparison is still required.
